answer_1.quote: We build IDK-MRC dataset by combining model-generated unanswerable questions with human-written questions.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models using the existing BLEU score metric.

answer_4.quote: We recruit four Indonesian native speakers with 2+ years of experience in Indonesian NLP dataset annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Unanswerability: whether the answer can be found in the given paragraph. Relevancy: whether the question is relevant to the paragraph and the answerable question. Fluency: whether the question is fluent.
